description.zh:
防护规则类型。目前仅支持取值：
- **global**：表示全局维度的规则。
description.en:
The type of the protection rule. Only the following value is supported:
- **global**: a global-level rule.

description.zh:
WAF实例ID。

> 您可以通过调用[DescribeInstance](~~433756~~)接口查看当前WAF实例ID。
description.en:
Instance ID of the WAF instance.

> You can call the [DescribeInstance](~~433756~~) operation to query instance ID of the current WAF instance.

description.zh: 分页查询时每页个数。取值范围为：1-100，默认值为20。
description.en: The number of entries per page in a paged query. Valid values: 1 to 100. Default value: 20.

description.zh:
下一页查询凭证（**Token**），如果有下一页，则该字段有返回值。

>该参数只要返回值，则说明还有下一页。您可以将返回的**NextToken**作为请求参数再次获得下一页的数据，直到无返回值，表示获取到了所有的数据。
description.en:
The pagination token (**Token**) for the next page. If a next page exists, this field has a return value.

> If this parameter has a return value, a next page exists. Use the returned **NextToken** as a request parameter to obtain the data on the next page. Repeat this process until no value is returned, which indicates that all data has been retrieved.

description.zh:
WAF实例所属地域。取值：

- **cn-hangzhou**：表示中国内地。

- **ap-southeast-1**：表示非中国内地。
description.en:
The region in which the WAF instance is deployed. Valid values:

- **cn-hangzhou**: the Chinese mainland.

- **ap-southeast-1**: outside the Chinese mainland.
The Alibaba Cloud resource group ID.
The ID of the rule to query.

title.zh: 分页查询关联防护规则
title.en: Query associated protection rules by paging

example.unifiedCli: aliyun waf-openapi describe-related-defense-rules --instance-id waf-cn-zz11sr50000 --rule-id 12345678 --defense-type global --next-token caeba0bbb2be03f84eb48b699f000000 --max-results 20 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-manager-resource-group-id rg-acfm000q --defense-scene address_book --api-version 2021-10-01 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun waf-openapi DescribeRelatedDefenseRules --region cn-hangzhou --ResourceManagerResourceGroupId 'rg-acfm000q' --NextToken caeba0bbb2be03f84eb48b699f000000 --InstanceId 'waf-cn-zz11sr50000' --RuleId 12345678 --MaxResults 20 --DefenseScene address_book --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --DefenseType global
